text: Sorry for the hour. I'm fostering a little lad, 4 years old, he's had the chickenpox since yesterday and he's scratching away at the spots, the creature, and he's 38 on the thermometer. Thing is his lips have gone a bit of a bluey colour and his skin looks sort of grey and blotchy, like marbled, not his normal colour at all. Otherwise he's grand in himself, chatting away, but I don't like the look of that colour. I'm wrecked, been up with him the last two nights, would you ring me back please
